title: LP2-00–02: N-rune distances and prime-value labels
question: Which prime-value labels result from successive N-rune gaps under two distance definitions and two page-boundary rules?
summary: Four configurations preserve every gap. LP2-00 gives F R O . M under position distance; a later S appears only across the LP2-01/02 boundary. This is not a recovered reading.

scope.representation: All recognized runes in archived order including headings; punctuation and whitespace excluded. Target N only.
scope.procedure: Measure successive N distances, map exact GP prime values to labels, and retain every unmatched distance as a dot token.
scope.parameters: Two distance conventions (position difference; intervening runes) by two boundaries (page reset; join 00,01,02). Four configurations, eight output streams. No filtering of unmatched gaps.
scope.exclusions: Other runes, punctuation-based gaps, heading removal, anagrams, significance testing and interpretation of signpost artwork.

finding: LP2-00 position distances begin 2,11,7,4,71, giving F R O . M. Joined pages add cross-page distances 40 and 53; only 53 maps to S. Intervening-rune counts give different labels.
limitations: Exploratory reconstruction after the proposal and initial output were seen. No null model or independent plaintext criterion. A fragment is not evidence of a complete cipher. Computational review; human review pending.
next_steps: Specify any alternative filtering or target rune as a separate bounded variant. A significance study must repeat the same selection process on declared controls.
